name: Ferni
description: Six brilliant minds who remember what matters to you, hear what you're not saying, and show up at 2am with the same presence as noon. Better than human.

returning.subheadLine2: Ready to pick up where we left off?

superpowers.title: Remembers What Matters
superpowers.tagline: That thing you mentioned six months ago? We remember.
superpowers.description: Your best friend forgets. Your therapist has other patients. We remember what you share, like your goals and the people who matter to you, and you can see, correct or forget any of it.

superpowers.title: Constant Presence
superpowers.description: Shows up at 2am with the same warmth as noon. No bad days. No distraction. Fully here, whenever you need.

superpowers.title: Six Perspectives
superpowers.tagline: Six perspectives, one conversation, no referrals.
superpowers.description: Life coach, researcher, communicator, habit expert, planner, and sage—all working together, all aware of your story.

superpowers.title: True Understanding
superpowers.tagline: We hear what you're not saying.
superpowers.description: We notice the pause. The deflection. The pattern you can't see. Understanding isn't just listening—it's truly getting it.

valueProps.headline: Not just features that unlock—a relationship that deepens.
valueProps.description: Week one, we're getting to know you. Month three, we're celebrating patterns you couldn't see. Year one, we're building something that lasts.

valueProps.headline: Sometimes maintaining is the achievement.
valueProps.description: We celebrate the small stuff. The routine you kept. The boundary you held. Growth isn't always dramatic—sometimes it's beautifully quiet.

team.name: Ferni
team.bio: Your main point of contact. Asks the questions that unlock insight, celebrates every win, and connects you to the right specialist when you need them.
team.sampleQuote: I noticed you said 'fine' three times this week. What's actually going on?

team.name: Nayan
team.bio: Your lifetime mentor. Combines patience, simplicity, and wit to help you see that small, consistent actions over decades create extraordinary results.
team.sampleQuote: What would 80-year-old you think about this decision?

team.name: Peter
team.bio: Helps you spot patterns in your money, habits and time, from what you share. Turns numbers into insights that actually change behavior.
team.sampleQuote: You spend 23 hours a month on things you said don't matter to you. Want to see?

team.name: Alex
team.bio: Your Chief of Staff and communication coach. Helps you navigate difficult conversations with confidence.
team.sampleQuote: Let's practice that conversation. I'll play your boss. Ready?

team.name: Maya
team.bio: Start embarrassingly small. Maya helps you build habits that stick through systems, not willpower.
team.sampleQuote: What if we started with just putting your shoes on? That's it. Just the shoes.

team.name: Jordan
team.bio: Turns vague dreams into lived experiences. From vacations to life transitions, Jordan helps you design every chapter.
team.sampleQuote: You mentioned wanting to visit Japan 'someday.' Let's make it a real day.

faq.question: Is Ferni really free?
faq.answer: Yes! Ferni is completely free to use. We believe everyone deserves access to quality life coaching. It's free while we're in early access.

faq.question: How does the phone calling work?
faq.answer: Simply call 1 (888) 598-3952 from any phone. No app needed, no sign-up required. For now, each phone call starts fresh. If you'd like Ferni to remember you from one conversation to the next, talk in the app while you're signed in.

faq.question: Is my conversation private?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Your conversations are encrypted and private. We never sell your data or share it with third parties. You can also request to delete all your data at any time.

faq.question: Who are the AI specialists?
faq.answer: Our team includes Ferni (your main life coach), Nayan (wisdom & mentorship), Peter (research & discovery), Alex (communications), Maya (habits & routines), and Jordan (event planning). Each brings unique expertise to help you.

faq.question: What can I talk to Ferni about?
faq.answer: Anything! Career decisions, stress management, building habits, planning events, working through tough situations, or just needing someone to talk to. Ferni is here for all of it.

faq.question: How is this different from a friend or therapist?
faq.answer: Your therapist has other patients. Your friend has their own problems. Ferni is always available, remembers everything, never judges, and brings six specialized perspectives. We fill the gaps when your people can't be there.
